race.comment: TRANSGRESS (4) ended a run of outs with a convincing win over this course and distance in a BM58 last start. Eligible for easier races but drops 4 kg on that last success and is an improver. Worth following. JADE TREES (2) has charged home from worse than midfield to win at both starts this prep, the latest over 1318m at Coffs Harbour under a steadier of 60kgs. Gets in well after Stokes' claim and should appreciate this longer trip. Hard to knock. WARRIOR BAE (5) continued a long run of good form when an eye-catching third recently over 1210m at this track. Will have no trouble with the step up in trip. One to watch for late in the piece. ENHANCE (1) doesn't win often but has been in the top three at 14 of 23 runs. Just missed in this grade over a shorter trip here last time. Sure to be thereabouts. WHISKEY MISS (7) has performed well at all four runs this prep. Slight query coming back in trip but will be strong late.
